target_zone_range.evidence_basis: Travis — UT PRC Rosaceae herbarium index includes P. caroliniana. Williamson — dedicated county treatment documents P. caroliniana. A third exact target-zone native county was not locked.
target_zone_range.blocking_issue: Fewer than three exact target-zone native counties locked.
target_zone_range.guardrail: Cultivated/introduced landscape records do not count as native county evidence.

morphology.look_here_first: Evergreen small tree with glossy leathery alternate leaves, short axillary racemes of small white flowers, black drupes, and a strong bitter-almond odor when twigs are scratched.
